string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_1
string.value: Added YouTube SABR/UMP streaming support, improving compatibility for new-format, high-resolution, and restricted videos

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_2
string.value: Refactored video extraction and client selection, aligned with PipePipe request behavior, restored remote signature decryption, reduced duplicate extraction and startup wait

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_3
string.value: Improved local DASH media proxy: separated A/V tracks, segmented cache, precise seeking, stream break recovery, and playback end handling

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_4
string.value: Added SABR PoToken support; optimized signature parameters, request headers, and binary response handling, reducing 403 / unable to play / loading failures

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_5
string.value: Improved player state sync, quality and audio track switching, fixed endless loading after playback, seek offset and audio track menu issues

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_6
string.value: Upgraded playlist parsing and pagination, compatible with new list structures, locked content, and continuation; improved list loading and continuous playback

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_7
string.value: Reorganized account and data management entry, improved linkage between sign-in state, watch history, local page, download options, and playback preferences

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_3_8
string.value: Improved home recommendations, video cards, theme color, picture-in-picture, and system media session; fixed multiple UI and playback stability issues

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_1
string.value: Player page adds Audio-only: turn off video and listen to sound, cover replaces picture, progress and controls still available

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_2
string.value: In audio-only mode, no picture-in-picture; returning to foreground keeps audio-only, manual resume required

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_3
string.value: Background can delay turning off video to save power (adjustable in playback settings)

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_4
string.value: Fixed system broadcast interruption: correct duck volume reduction, avoid secondary compression causing silence

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_5
string.value: Smoother landscape/portrait, fullscreen, and windowed playback, reduced screen black and blur

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_6
string.value: Home page after login better matches account state, can sync cloud watch history and subscriptions

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_7
string.value: Clearer video cards, live badges, and page safe area display

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_2_8
string.value: Support app handoff and tap-to-share video links

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_1_3
string.value: Fixed inability to watch after login

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_1_4
string.value: Fixed information bar popping up incorrectly in landscape mode

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_1_6
string.value: Completed local decryption logic verification, ready for deployment

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_0_1
string.value: Replaced system playback engine and third-party FFMpeg with MPVPlayer

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_0_2
string.value: Restored high-resolution playback and subtitle features

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_0_3
string.value: Support HEVC/H.264 hardware decoding; on API 23+ try VP9/AV1 hardware decoding

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_0_5
string.value: Optimized network transport library capabilities in non-login state

string.name: yt_changelog_0_4_1_3
string.value: Allowed Google sign-in, basically eliminated bot protection issues

string.name: yt_changelog_0_4_1_4
string.value: Optimized fullscreen interaction for various devices

string.name: yt_changelog_0_4_1_5
string.value: Developed multiple modules of the player page

string.name: yt_changelog_0_4_1_8
string.value: Integrated system and cast entry, experimental initial app handoff

string.value: Basically completed yt-dlp ecosystem analysis and integration interface

string.name: yt_changelog_0_4_0_2
string.value: Allowed Google sign-in, basically eliminated bot protection issues

string.name: yt_changelog_0_4_0_4
string.value: Used cloud decoding instead of local decoding, more stable

string.value: Improved page stack and mini-window playback

string.name: yt_changelog_0_3_1_2
string.value: Added server cache for smoother playback

string.name: yt_changelog_0_3_1_5

string.value: Initial Google sign-in development, verified pipepipe sign-in feasibility

string.value: Reverted to system-level player to improve lifecycle

string.value: Removed many previous libraries and headers, simplified to prevent bugs

string.name: yt_changelog_0_3_0_6
string.value: Initial Google sign-in development, verified smarttube feasibility

string.value: Refactored project code, optimized lifecycle management and development speed, fresh start

string.value: Initial release: basic YouTube video browsing and search

string.name: yt_changelog_0_1_0_3
string.value: Support channel subscriptions, favorites, and playlist management

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_4_1
string.value: 完善本地 JS 签名解密与磁盘缓存，冷启动预热并支持失败回退，减少依赖远程解密时的等待与失败

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_4_2
string.value: 补齐 DASH 音轨元数据（xtags/acont），按内容语言与原声轨偏好自动选择默认音轨，减少多语言片误选配音

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_4_3
string.value: 播放页新增睡眠定时器，到时停止播放并退出；点赞/播放量按语言本地化显示，并优化信息区配色

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_4_4
string.value: 对齐全部界面语言文案键，修复设置项与关于页出现 [object Object] 的问题，补全简体中文资源

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_4_5
string.value: 默认主题色改为红色，并新增播放页控制区/信息区背景色以提升对比度

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_4_6
string.value: 首页支持下拉刷新；清理全部数据时同步清理鉴权偏好、缩略图缓存与解密缓存（保留已下载媒体）

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_4_7
string.value: 完善网络请求日志与提取链路诊断信息，便于定位加载失败与鉴权相关问题

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_4_8
string.value: 同步更新 MPV 运行库，并修复播放与界面相关的多处稳定性问题

string.name: yt_secure_shield_content
string.value: 系统已开启坚盾守护模式并禁用 JIT。本地签名解密不可用，将改用远端解密服务，视频起播可能更慢。

string.name: yt_option_auth_use_for_user_data
string.value: Use login state for user data

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_1
string.value: Detects Secure Shield/JIT restrictions at startup and clearly explains when remote signature decryption will be used

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_2
string.value: Home and subscription cards now rebuild reliably after pull-to-refresh, including cases where item IDs stay unchanged

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_3
string.value: Added persistent master, user-data, and playback login controls so account access can be managed independently

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_4
string.value: Turning off login for user data now falls back to anonymous Home and local feeds instead of showing empty authenticated responses

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_5
string.value: Turning off login for playback now selects anonymous player clients and keeps SABR downloads free of account credentials

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_6
string.value: Player recommendations now use the stable anonymous YouTube next response, fixing empty queues while signed in

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_7
string.value: Stabilized authenticated playback client selection and LOGIN_REQUIRED handling for restricted videos

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_8
string.value: Uses signature timestamps from watch pages first, reducing startup delay before falling back to the remote player service

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_9
string.value: Added cached player metadata and tighter remote-decryption timeouts so slow services cannot block playback for long

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_10
string.value: Added cached base64url PoToken injection for DASH URLs to reduce googlevideo 403 errors without making token failure fatal

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_11
string.value: Fixed Save to Playlist, Stream Info, and Sleep Timer panels by consolidating their conflicting bottom-sheet bindings

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_12
string.value: Improved authenticated playlist and user-library browsing while preserving anonymous and local fallbacks when account use is disabled

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_13
string.value: Private browsing can now mask both account surfaces without deleting saved credentials, making it easy to return to signed-in mode

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_14
string.value: Changing the master or playback login switch immediately reselects the correct anonymous or authenticated player client

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_15
string.value: History and subscription cloud sync now follow the user-data switch while keeping existing local history and subscriptions available

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_16
string.value: Playlist browse requests can use account access when needed, improving loading of account-specific and restricted playlists

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_17
string.value: PoToken generation now shares the current resolved YouTube web-client version instead of relying on a stale fixed version

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_18
string.value: PoToken bytes are converted to URL-safe base64 and cached per video for five minutes to avoid repeated token generation

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_19
string.value: User-data and playback requests now apply credentials only within their selected scope, reducing unintended account-cookie exposure

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_5_20
string.value: Expanded playback, authentication, token, refresh, and fallback diagnostics while keeping sensitive cookies and signed URLs out of logs

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_7_1
string.value: 关于页新增「检查更新」：对比 GitHub 最新 Release 的构建号，发现新版本可一键跳转 AppGallery 测试安装或 GitHub 发布页

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_7_2
string.value: 新增订阅动态页：按时间聚合订阅频道更新；播放列表记录观看历史并显示进度徽标；列表适配宽屏布局

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_7_3
string.value: 新增「自动播放下一个」设置开关；关于页补全开源项目标识；媒体数据请求支持走 HTTP 代理

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_7_4
string.value: 起播提速：播放中预提取队列下一视频、BotGuard 开机预热、STS/客户端版本元数据落盘复用

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_7_5
string.value: 直播支持 HLS 多画质变体解析与切换；SIDX 索引启动预取；visitorData 会话级钉扎减少重复取流

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_7_6
string.value: SABR 稳定性：PoToken 铸造加超时与熔断、空响应即时补发 PoToken、会话构建失败正确释放租约

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_7_7
string.value: 修复自动连播重复触发与换源竞态（源提交收敛为单一写入方）；修复画中画关闭/恢复泄漏与观看历史合并顺序

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_7_8
string.value: 修复 HarmonyOS 6 视频无画面（OHNativeWindow 直传 mpv）；硬件解码能力改为按设备探测声明

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_6_1
string.value: SmartTube-style device QR sign-in for YouTube OAuth; can coexist with Cookie login

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_6_2
string.value: Dual-rail Cookie/WEB + OAuth/TV auth for home, history, subscriptions, and library; public streams stay on mweb, restricted content may fall back to TV

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_6_3
string.value: HTTP proxy settings for extractor, SABR, and media requests (loopback playback stays direct)

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_6_4
string.value: Video chapters in the player with jump-to-chapter and current-chapter highlight

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_6_5
string.value: Better split-screen / floating-window behavior; collapse top player tools into a More menu when space is tight

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_6_6
string.value: Rebuilt playback media lifecycle for more reliable start, source switch, and multi-window use

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_6_7
string.value: Show loading/buffering immediately when changing quality

string.name: yt_changelog_0_5_6_8
string.value: Redesigned download list and list entrance animations; improved SABR offline packaging; hide live download entry

string.name: yt_option_help_subtitle
string.value: 新手引导与基础使用说明

string.name: yt_guide_p1_desc
string.value: 开源的 YouTube 第三方客户端：本地 MPV 播放、无广告，数据只保存在你自己的设备上。

string.name: yt_guide_p2_desc
string.value: 在「设置 → 数据与账户」中通过网页或扫码登录。登录后可以查看你的订阅和播放列表等账户内容；不登录也可以以访客身份正常使用。

string.name: yt_guide_p3_desc
string.value: 登录凭据只保存在本机，不会上传到任何第三方服务器。你可以随时在「数据与账户」中退出登录或开启隐身模式，退出后账户数据将被清除。

string.name: yt_guide_p3_user_data
string.value: 用于用户数据：获取订阅、历史等账户数据

string.name: yt_guide_p3_playback
string.value: 用于播放：登录身份请求 URL，避免人机验证

string.name: yt_guide_p4_desc
string.value: 网络受限时，可在「设置 → 网络」中启用 HTTP 或 SOCKS5 代理，并填写服务器地址和端口。代理仅用于外部网络请求，本地播放回环地址不会经过代理。

string.name: yt_guide_p5_desc
string.value: 在「设置 → 播放」中可以设置默认清晰度、移动网络清晰度和缓存时长，按需节省流量或提升画质。

string.name: yt_guide_p6_desc
string.value: 支持把视频下载到本地离线观看，下载内容在「本地」页管理。「清除全部数据」不会删除你已下载的文件。
